# evalops capability matrix

<!-- Generated by `make capabilities` from src/evalops/presets.py and each plugin class's
     own `provides` metadata. Do not edit by hand: tests/unit/test_presets.py fails when
     this file drifts from the code. -->

`evalops init --preset <name>` renders one of the seven D8 presets. Every preset also renders
a `local` environment (prompts/datasets are repo files, the ledger is SQLite, no service), so
a project can always fall back offline. `evalops capabilities --json` emits the same matrix.

## Presets

| Preset | Environments | prompts | datasets | ledger | tracer | evaluator | Extras |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `local` | `local` | `git` | `git` | `sql` | `none` | `core` | — |
| `mlflow` | `local`, `mlflow` | `mlflow` | `mlflow` | `mlflow` | `mlflow` | `mlflow` | `mlflow` |
| `databricks` | `databricks`, `local` | `mlflow` | `mlflow` | `mlflow` | `mlflow` | `mlflow` | `databricks` |
| `langfuse` | `langfuse`, `local` | `langfuse` | `langfuse` | `sql` | `langfuse` | `langfuse` | `langfuse` |
| `langsmith` | `langsmith`, `local` | `langsmith` | `langsmith` | `sql` | `langsmith` | `langsmith` | `langsmith` |
| `logfire` | `local`, `logfire` | `git` | `git` | `sql` | `logfire` | `core` | `logfire` |
| `mixed` | `local`, `mixed` | `git` | `git` | `sql` | `logfire` | `core` | `logfire` |

## Preset notes

- `local` — zero external services: prompts/datasets are repo files and the ledger is SQLite
- `mlflow` — one self-hosted MLflow server serves all five roles (tracking server + genai registry)
- `databricks` — MLflow on a Databricks workspace: Unity Catalog prompts, datasets and run ledger
- `langfuse` — Langfuse prompts, datasets, tracing and native evaluation; SQL run ledger
- `langsmith` — LangSmith prompts, datasets, tracing and native evaluation; SQL run ledger
- `logfire` — Logfire traces every row; prompts/datasets stay in git and the core evaluator runs the eval
- `mixed` — roles compose: git prompts/datasets, SQL ledger, Logfire traces, core evaluator

Install a preset's extras with `pip install .[<extra>]` before running `evalops doctor`.
The `Extra` column below is the optional dependency that installs a plugin's SDK; `sql`
needs none for SQLite (the `sql` extra adds the Postgres/MySQL drivers).

## Built-in plugins

| Plugin | prompts | datasets | ledger | tracer | evaluator | Aliases | Extra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `core` |  |  |  | ✓ | ✓ | `none` | — |
| `git` | ✓ | ✓ |  |  |  | — | — |
| `langfuse` | ✓ | ✓ |  | ✓ | ✓ | — | `langfuse` |
| `langsmith` | ✓ | ✓ |  | ✓ | ✓ | — | `langsmith` |
| `logfire` |  |  |  | ✓ |  | — | `logfire` |
| `mlflow` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | — | `mlflow` |
| `sql` |  |  | ✓ |  |  | — | — |

## Legal plugins per role

| Role | Plugins |
|---|---|
| `prompts` | `git`, `langfuse`, `langsmith`, `mlflow` |
| `datasets` | `git`, `langfuse`, `langsmith`, `mlflow` |
| `ledger` | `mlflow`, `sql` |
| `tracer` | `core`, `langfuse`, `langsmith`, `logfire`, `mlflow`, `none` |
| `evaluator` | `core`, `langfuse`, `langsmith`, `mlflow`, `none` |

A third-party plugin (an `evalops.plugins` entry point, or `module:Class`) may serve any
subset of the roles. Asking a plugin for a role it does not provide is exit 6 with a hint
naming what it does provide.
